services.desc: Bogan’s Deep Sea Fishing Center offers a wide variety of deep sea fishing and party boat fishing trips in New Jersey, targeting seasonal species throughout the year. From Sea Bass, Porgies, Fluke, Ling, Cod, and Striped Bass to offshore canyon Tuna trips, our fleet sailing from Brielle, NJ provides daily fishing opportunities along the Jersey Shore. Each trip offers a different experience-from inshore and bottom fishing to offshore canyon runs-with options for anglers of all experience levels.
